### AIDataEditorWorkflow

This repository contains an LLM workflow specification and open-source tools for reproducing, improving and extending published economics research. The repository is a work in progress.

To apply the workflow to a piece of research, see [WORKFLOW.md](../WORKFLOW.md); the tools and their installation are described in [this readme](../README.md).

To see the results of applying the workflow to published articles, see [AIDataEditorDatabasePublic](https://github.com/MetaEconomics/AIDataEditorDatabasePublic).

To read more about the project, see [NBER working paper 35782](https://www.nber.org/papers/w35782).

To report a bug or suggest a change, open a new issue and be as specific as possible: the file or tool family, the command you ran, the engine and its version, and the log lines you saw.
